name: checkin_pop
description: A happy bubble pop confirms a daily check-in.
sound: One plump bubble pop with a tiny upward wooden-plink sparkle.

name: xp_ding
description: A bright bell rewards earned XP.
sound: One tiny bright toy glockenspiel ding with a soft sparkling tail.

name: level_up_fanfare
description: A silly toy fanfare celebrates a new level.
sound: Three ascending toy trumpet notes ending in a triumphant squeaky kazoo flourish.

name: coin_purchase
description: A coin clink and cash-register chirp confirm a purchase.
sound: One small gold coin clinks into a ceramic piggy bank followed by a tiny register ding.

name: equip_swoosh
description: A soft swoosh and click equip an item.
sound: A short airy cloth swoosh ending with a satisfying soft wooden click.

name: crown_ceremony
description: A miniature regal flourish crowns the weekly winner.
sound: A miniature regal toy trumpet flourish followed by three twinkly ascending bell notes, slightly pompous and funny.

name: mayor_gong
description: A mellow little gong introduces the Mayor.
sound: One gentle small brass desk gong with a warm round bloom and a short decay, ending quietly to make space for speech.

name: prayer_chime
description: Soft wind chimes mark a peaceful prayer.
sound: Two delicate glass wind chimes with a peaceful airy shimmer and gentle short decay.

name: event_drumroll
description: A toy drumroll announces a village event.
sound: A tiny toy snare drumroll building quickly into one soft comic rimshot.

name: evidence_stamp_ok
description: A rubber stamp and chirp approve submitted evidence.
sound: One chunky rubber stamp thump on paper immediately followed by a cheerful two-note electronic approval chirp.

name: evidence_buzzer_sus
description: A goofy suspicious honk flags questionable evidence.
sound: One funny questioning rubber duck honk with a downward then upward nasal pitch wobble, skeptical but friendly, never alarming.

name: pet_bark_happy
description: A tiny cartoon puppy gives two happy yips.
sound: Two happy tiny cartoon puppy yips, bouncy and soft, with a faint collar jingle.

name: building_unlock_tada
description: A wooden pop and musical ta-da unlock a building.
sound: A satisfying wooden block pop followed by a playful ascending toy xylophone ta-da flourish, purely instrumental.

name: crater_boom_cartoon
description: A cushioned cartoon boom makes a crater.
sound: One muffled cartoon poof-boom with a rubbery bass bounce and tiny falling pebble ticks, comic and gentle, no realistic explosion.

name: poke_boing
description: A springy boing reacts to a friendly poke.
sound: One short rubber spring boing with a silly descending pitch wobble.

name: message_blip
description: A soft two-note blip announces a message.
sound: Two very short rounded electronic toy blips stepping upward, a gentle friendly notification.

name: night_crickets_loop
description: Quiet looping crickets provide cozy nighttime ambience.
sound: Seamlessly looping quiet summer-night crickets, tiny rhythmic chirps over a very soft warm breeze, steady texture throughout, no foreground events, no fade in or fade out.

name: festival_crowd_loop
description: A gentle looping crowd brings the village festival to life.
sound: Seamlessly looping small cheerful cartoon village festival crowd, soft indistinct happy murmurs and scattered gentle chuckles with distant tiny bell jingles, no intelligible words, no music, steady texture throughout, no fade in or fade out.
